caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt composed of a geometric pattern. The central area is divided into a grid of nine large squares, each filled with blue, scale-like oval segments arranged in rows and bordered by alternating green and red diamond shapes. The green diamonds form diagonal lines intersected by the red diamonds at the points, with the red diamonds featuring a small white center mark. Around this central grid are several borders: first, a narrow solid green band, followed by a broader yellow border decorated with small floral designs in red and blue, and an interior strip of red with vertical lines. This is enclosed by an additional green border with spaced lines, and the entire quilt has a light blue edge. The background is plain and light-colored, emphasizing the colors and patterns of the quilt itself.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
